model_family: Frozen pretrained Trackastra association representation plus fit-only linear conflict head

literature_evidence.citation: Gallusser B, Weigert M. Trackastra: Transformer-based cell tracking for live-cell microscopy. ECCV 2024.
literature_evidence.reported_result: Trackastra learns contextual pairwise associations with parental normalization across temporal detection windows.
literature_evidence.task_relevance: The frozen checkpoint supplies the cross-video temporal association signal that passed the local preregistered ranking probe.

literature_evidence.citation: Lalit M et al. An Investigation of Unsupervised Cell Tracking and Interactive Fine-Tuning. ICCV 2025 BIC Workshop.
literature_evidence.reported_result: The work studies small association objectives and parameter-efficient adaptation around Trackastra.
literature_evidence.task_relevance: It supports testing a frozen representation with a small supervised head before any adapter or full-model training.

hypothesis.observed_failure_mode: APNCC and compact learned rankers identify useful challengers but do not transfer association confidence consistently across crowded 6bba videos.
hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: A pinned pretrained temporal representation adds a cross-video challenger-versus-incumbent margin to exact APNCC/context rows; a nested fit-only linear head calibrates the combined evidence while the body remains frozen.
hypothesis.falsification_test: PARK before validation12/CV57 unless nested held proposal precision reaches 0.95 overall and 0.93 in every fold, then exact held-fit graphs improve adjusted edge Jaccard by at least 0.005 without raw-score or node-recall regression.

early_stop_conditions: Stop on any checkpoint, source, feature, split, cache, scorer, or proposal identity drift.
Stop on any memory, system-free-memory, or swap guard violation.
Stop if label-free feature generation cannot cover all 69 videos and 110471 proposals in three hours.
Stop before graph reconstruction if nested held proposal precision/support gates fail.
Stop before validation12/CV57 if exact held-fit adjusted edge Jaccard gain is below 0.005, raw edge Jaccard regresses, node recall regresses, or fragments are observation-identical.
success_criteria: The frozen label-free feature cache covers 69 videos, 110471 proposals and 5824 transition calls with exact authenticated identities.
Nested grouped-OOF proposal precision is at least 0.95 overall, every fold is at least 0.93, and held support is at least 1000 proposals.
Exact held-fit graph adjusted edge Jaccard is at least 0.005 above APNCC, raw edge Jaccard and node recall do not regress, and all held fragments are observation-distinct.
The Trackastra body remains frozen and no LoRA, validation12, CV57, GPU, Kaggle, or RunPod action occurs.
